automation.title: Automation
automation.emptyHint: Rules fire when triggers match — e.g. auto-assign high-priority tickets, notify a team on SLA breach.
automation.drawerHint: Conditions are AND-joined; if all match, actions run in order. Conditions on `context.<field>` reference the trigger payload.
automation.sectionMetaHint: Higher priority rules run first within the same trigger.
automation.sectionConditionsHint: All conditions must match. Reference fields with dot paths (e.g. context.priority).
automation.sectionActionsHint: Actions run in order. Params are stored as JSON on the rule.
automation.sectionStatusHint: Inactive rules are stored but never fire.
automation.name: Name
automation.noConditions: No conditions — rule fires on every trigger.
automation.loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.
automation.heroSubtitle: Rules fire when a trigger matches — conditions are AND-joined, then actions run in order to assign, tag, escalate, or notify automatically.

reports.emptyHint: Create a saved report to schedule periodic emails or run on demand from this list.
reports.drawerHint: Filters scope the data; the email schedule runs the report and sends a CSV.
reports.sectionMetaHint: Pick a report type — each computes a different aggregation.

reports.name: Name
reports.loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.

reports.freqManualHint: Nothing is sent automatically — only "Run now".
reports.cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.
reports.scheduleNoRecipients: It will run on schedule, but with no recipients nobody receives it.

customFields.name: Name

imports.title: Import contacts
imports.vendorHint: Dedup runs per-vendor on phone OR email.

imports.heroSubtitle: Upload a CSV, map its columns to contact fields, preview the first rows, then queue the import. Deduplication runs per-vendor on phone or email.

aiConfig.title: AI assistance
aiConfig.subtitle: Toggle features and set a monthly call budget.
aiConfig.featuresHint: Disabled features return a clean error to the caller — no provider hit, no usage charge.
aiConfig.budgetHint: Max provider calls per calendar month, across all features. 0 = unlimited.
aiConfig.helpBudgetHint: Max help-assistant questions each staff member can ask per day. 0 = unlimited.

helpAssistant.title: Ask AI help
helpAssistant.description: Ask how something works in this CRM. Follow-up questions keep their context; the chat is cleared when you close this panel and nothing is saved.
helpAssistant.label: Your question
helpAssistant.placeholder: How do I add an agent to a team?
helpAssistant.offTopic: That looks outside what this assistant covers — it only answers questions about this CRM.

error.disabled: AI help is turned off by your administrator.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests — try again in {{seconds}}s.
error.quota: You’ve used your daily AI help allowance ({{limit}}). It resets at {{time}}.
error.invalid: Ask a question between 3 and 500 characters.
error.generic: Couldn’t get an answer. Please try again.

helpAssistant.empty: Ask about the inbox, tickets, SLA, reports, contacts, automation or the widget. Follow-up questions work — the chat clears when you close this panel.

sla.sectionPrioritiesHint: Tickets with these priorities will be governed by this policy.

users.sectionIdentityHint: Who they are. Name is optional; email is the unique handle.
users.sectionAccessHint: Role decides what they can do. Team decides where conversations route.
users.sectionCredentialsHint: Set an initial password and their default UI language.
users.loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.
users.heroSubtitle: Everyone who can sign in to Yiji — their role, team, and account status at a glance. Select anyone to edit access or reset a password.

slaReports.drillHint: Click an agent to see their tickets.
slaReports.emptyHint: Widen the date range, or wait for tickets with SLA targets to land.
slaReports.subtitle: Which TICKETS met the deadline they were promised
slaReports.title: SLA performance
slaReports.scopeNote: One row per TICKET, judged against the deadline its SLA policy promised. Use it to find the breaches and who held them. For a per-agent rollup with CSAT see Agent KPI; for chat response times see Agent performance — those measure conversations, not tickets, so their numbers are not these ones.

agentReports.subtitle: On-demand Excel downloads of ticket, agent and conversation data — export now, no schedule.

agentReports.previewRows: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} rows — the export covers all.
agentReports.previewDays: Showing the last {{shown}} of {{total}} days — the export covers all.

agentReports.conversationsSubtitle: Conversations by status, priority and day — export to Excel.

complaintDash.agentPerfHint: Complaints handled, how many are finished, and what they cost.
complaintDash.unattributed: {{n}} complaint(s) have no branch recorded and are missing from this cut.

complaintDash.byAreaHint: The area manager responsible for the branch.
complaintDash.unsolvedHint: {{n}} still open across the filtered range.

complaintDash.funnelHint: Each stage against everything logged in range.

performance.title: Agent performance
performance.fastHelp: Averages per agent — shorter is better
performance.speedPerDayHelp: A gap is a day nothing was measurable
performance.nothingMeasured: No chat in this range has been answered yet, so there is nothing to plot.
performance.basis: First response is measured from the customer’s first message to the first agent reply; internal notes do not count as a reply. Chats nobody has answered are counted under “No reply yet” and left out of the averages, but they still count against “Answered in time”.
performance.commonTitle: Chats picked up for the team
performance.commonHelp: Chats answered after somebody else let them go
performance.commonBasis: A chat the system had to pass on is left out of the response-time figures — it carries the wait the earlier agents caused — and counted here instead, for whoever picked it up.
performance.summaryHint: Every agent with chats in this range, busiest first.

storeNotify.rulesTitle: Complaints the branch is told about
storeNotify.rulesHelp: A ticket is reported to its branch only when its complaint type is selected here. The branch receives the description and the resolution notes — nothing else about the customer.
storeNotify.noneSelected: Nothing is selected, so no branch is told about anything. Pick the complaint types a branch can act on.
storeNotify.pendingTransport: Delivery to the stores is not connected yet

lists.title: Complaint types
lists.help: These values feed the complaint form live — no deploy needed. Retire a value to stop offering it; tickets that already carry it keep displaying it. The exact spellings are what reports group by, so a corrected spelling is a new value, not an edit.
lists.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{value}}” outright? Retiring is safer — tickets already carrying it keep displaying it either way.
lists.duplicate: That value is already on this list.
lists.empty: This list has no values yet.

roles.title: Roles & privileges
roles.saved: Saved — the role and its permissions are being applied now.
roles.builtinHelp: Built-in roles are defined in code, where their security hardening lives, and cannot be edited here. Create a new role for anything these two do not cover.
roles.name: Role name
roles.brandsHelp: Tick brands to fence this role to them: their tickets, their branches, their names in the pickers. Nothing ticked means every brand. Tickets not yet linked to a branch stay visible either way, and chats cannot be brand-fenced — a conversation has no brand until a ticket gives it one.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Users still holding it must be reassigned first.
roles.assignHint: Assign people to this role from the Users page once it shows Active.

backup.title: Backup
backup.exportHelp: Every business collection — tickets, chats, contacts, lists, settings — as one JSON file on your machine. Restoring is an operator action: hand the file to whoever runs the system, with scripts/restore-backup.mjs.
backup.partial: Backup saved, but {{n}} collection(s) could not be read — see the list.
